verdict.rationale: Undermind documents uploading PDFs to a workspace and searching and reading papers already there. However, upload is framed around reading paywalled versions of papers it has already found, not ingesting an arbitrary private corpus. Its full-text PDF Q&A then works across those workspace papers. Missing for 10: explicit support for uploading arbitrary or unpublished documents or a bulk corpus, documentation of the upload workflow and its limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of research over user-uploaded files.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can upload my own PDFs or corpus and have the agent research over them

citations.quote: paywalled PDFs can be read after workspace upload.
Searches the global literature, papers already in the workspace, or a paper’s references and citations in seconds.
Reads full-text PDFs in parallel and answers specific questions across many papers at once, including from figures, tables, and equations.
Unlimited workspaces, files, and paper libraries
